pairs.evidence: app/_components/Select.test.ts:8 Select's commit/typeahead/navigation decisions live inside the .tsx, which the node:test runner can't load, so its tests match regexes against the source text: they pin the implementation's spelling, not the behaviour, which is the failure seams-and-adapters names for code with no seam.

techniques.evidence: app/_components/Select.test.ts:8 Without a seam, tests pin internals by source regex (e.g. the disabled-row refusal, the typeahead timer cleanup). Only selectConsumesKeyWhileOpen was extracted.

app/_components/TextInput.tsx:16 Forwarding the native input surface is correct because the wrapper adds a capability (theme-correct base styling) rather than drawing a distinction.

pairs.registryProposal: seams-and-adapters could name a mechanical tell for UI layers: a test that readFileSync's a component's source and regex-matches it is the 'tests that reach into internals' failure, made visible when the runner cannot load the host format (.tsx).
